cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Who Changed It?
cards.instruction: Ask innocent questions until someone admits altering the plan, schedule, arrangement, or shared space.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The picnic has moved from Saturday to Friday. I'll approve the calendar once we've clarified whose blue pen this is.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine. Can I have it back? Everyone uses it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Return is approved after one small detail. Whose handwriting adds hearts to Fridays?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All right, I changed it. Sam said Friday would work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Friday is under consideration. Did Sam ask for the change, or did you offer him our Friday? Just establishing the order.

reason: Use permission to return the pen to sustain innocent fact questions; after B admits the change and names Sam, probe that actual contribution rather than attaching a new unrelated task.
